dataset: Godfrin et al. helium-4 dispersion, arXiv:2012.09067v1
frequency_semantics: authored positive rescaling, not unscaled E/h or a natural audible frequency
exactness_scope: published decimal representations; experimental uncertainty remains
missing_values: retain q/pressure and missing status; numerical receiver fields are null; never interpolate or replace with zero
zero_energy: frequency target zero, no MIDI note; distinct from missing; not present in this dataset

rank.scope: six selected values within each pressure
rank.ties: equal reported values share a rank
rank.uncertainty: rank nominal values; separately report overlap of +/- reported errors

quantized_midi.rule: nearest note; exact 24th-power threshold comparisons; ties upward
quantized_midi.out_of_range: reject outside MIDI 0..127 reference frequencies; never clamp

timeline.ordering: ascending pressure, then the six declared ascending wavevectors
timeline.scope: authored comparison timeline; not physical time

uncertainty: multiply reported error by the same 400 Hz/meV factor; do not assume an error distribution, independence, or confidence level
common_scale_receiver: exact rational frequency controls in observations.json and events.csv; no claim that ordinary MIDI reproduces these targets
midi_receiver: symbolic control only; no pitch bend, waveform, timbre or listener claim
claim_boundary: measured helium pressure profiles and mapping preservation; no normal/superfluid phase classification, E8 identification in helium, or theory of everything
